name: claim_duplicate_check
xsql:
SELECT Nvl(COUNT(1), 0)                                          AS dup_count,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN 'block' ELSE 'none' END        AS dup_display,
       Nvl(MAX(c.status), '')                                     AS dup_status,
       Nvl(MAX(c.claim_id), '')                                   AS dup_claim_id
FROM   claim.claim_request c
WHERE  c.order_code = :v_order_code
  AND  c.item_code  = :v_item_code
